    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">制造业质量追溯01：最小测试用例与 Oracle 层次查询演示</span>
    

</a>
</h2>
    <small>
<span id="post-date" data-last-update-days="0" data-date-updated="2026-09-23 07:25">2026-09-23 07:25</span>&nbsp;
<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jyzhao">AlfredZhao</a>&nbsp;
阅读(<span id="post_view_count">82</span>)&nbsp;
评论(<span id="post_comment_count">0</span>)&nbsp;
&nbsp;
<a href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="AddToWz(23087915);return false;">收藏</a>&nbsp;
<a href="https://report.cnblogs.com?targetLink=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnblogs.com%2Fjyzhao%2Fp%2F23087915&amp;targetId=23087915&amp;targetType=0" target="_blank">举报</a>
</small>
    <div class="entry">
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本文以大家都熟悉的汽车轮胎举例，在其对应的制造场景与供应链场景中（注：场景已简化，实际要更复杂），质量追溯是一个典型的多级父子结构问题。</p>
<p>追溯链条通常为：原材料（天然橡胶、炭黑、钢丝帘线批次）→ 胶料/半成品（混炼胶、胎面、胎圈）→ 成型轮胎成品（唯一 DOT 码/胎号）→ 销售客户。本文约定：正查（Forward Tracking）从原材料批次出发，找出流向的所有成品与客户，用于缺陷召回；反查（Backward Tracking）从问题轮胎出发，向上追查所用半成品与原材料，用于客诉归因。注意不同企业/标准对“正查/反查”的命名可能相反，请以所在组织的术语约定为准。</p>
<p>下面笔者用一套最小用例，在 Oracle 26ai 中把这条链路跑通。</p>
<p>追溯链条的层级关系可以用一张图概括，正查与反查恰好是沿这张图的两个相反方向遍历：</p>
<div class="mermaid">flowchart LR
    R1["RAW-RUBBER-001&lt;br/&gt;天然橡胶-01批次"] --&gt; C["SEMI-COMPOUND-101&lt;br/&gt;混炼胶-101批次"]
    R2["RAW-CARBON-002&lt;br/&gt;炭黑-02批次"] --&gt; C
    C --&gt; T["SEMI-TREAD-201&lt;br/&gt;胎面-201批次"]
    T --&gt; F1["FG-TIRE-DOT-8888&lt;br/&gt;225/55R17 轮胎A"]
    T --&gt; F2["FG-TIRE-DOT-9999&lt;br/&gt;225/55R17 轮胎B"]
    F1 --&gt; CU["CUST-TESLA-01&lt;br/&gt;客户-特斯拉工厂"]
</div><p>图中从原材料指向客户的方向即<strong>正查（Forward Tracking）</strong>，从成品轮胎回溯到原材料的方向即<strong>反查（Backward Tracking）</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="01--建表批次节点与追溯关系">01 | 建表：批次节点与追溯关系</h2>
<p>追溯的核心是记录物料与批次的层级演变关系。笔者用两张表表达：<code>lot_master</code> 记录批次属性，<code>lot_genealogy</code> 记录父批次到子批次的消耗关系。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CREATE TABLE lot_master (
    lot_id       VARCHAR2(50) PRIMARY KEY,
    item_name    VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL,
    item_type    VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL, -- RAW/SEMI/FG/CUST
    produce_date DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE
);

CREATE TABLE lot_genealogy (
    parent_lot_id VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL,
    child_lot_id  VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL,
    quantity_used NUMBER,
    CONSTRAINT pk_lot_genealogy PRIMARY KEY (parent_lot_id, child_lot_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_parent_lot FOREIGN KEY (parent_lot_id) REFERENCES lot_master(lot_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_child_lot  FOREIGN KEY (child_lot_id)  REFERENCES lot_master(lot_id)
);
</code></pre>
<p>两张表的分工可以这样理解：<code>lot_master</code> 是节点表，<code>lot_genealogy</code> 是边表，二者组合起来就是一张有向图。</p>
<div class="mermaid">erDiagram
    LOT_MASTER ||--o{ LOT_GENEALOGY : "作为父批次"
    LOT_MASTER ||--o{ LOT_GENEALOGY : "作为子批次"
    LOT_MASTER {
        VARCHAR2 lot_id PK
        VARCHAR2 item_name
        VARCHAR2 item_type
        DATE produce_date
    }
    LOT_GENEALOGY {
        VARCHAR2 parent_lot_id PK,FK
        VARCHAR2 child_lot_id PK,FK
        NUMBER quantity_used
    }
</div><h2 id="02--造数一条完整生产链">02 | 造数：一条完整生产链</h2>
<p>笔者构造一条简单链路：天然橡胶 <code>RAW-RUBBER-001</code> 与炭黑 <code>RAW-CARBON-002</code> 混炼成胶料 <code>SEMI-COMPOUND-101</code>，再做成胎面 <code>SEMI-TREAD-201</code>，组装成两条轮胎 <code>FG-TIRE-DOT-8888</code>、<code>FG-TIRE-DOT-9999</code>，其中 8888 发给客户 <code>CUST-TESLA-01</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- 前置条件：已执行第 01 节的建表语句；本脚本会清空 lot_genealogy 与 lot_master，
-- 仅可在测试库/测试 schema 中执行，请勿在生产库运行。
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM lot_genealogy;
    DELETE FROM lot_master;

    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('RAW-RUBBER-001','天然橡胶-01批次','RAW',DATE '2026-01-01');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('RAW-CARBON-002','炭黑-02批次','RAW',DATE '2026-01-01');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('SEMI-COMPOUND-101','混炼胶-101批次','SEMI',DATE '2026-01-02');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('SEMI-TREAD-201','胎面-201批次','SEMI',DATE '2026-01-03');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('FG-TIRE-DOT-8888','225/55R17 轮胎A','FG',DATE '2026-01-05');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('FG-TIRE-DOT-9999','225/55R17 轮胎B','FG',DATE '2026-01-05');
    INSERT INTO lot_master VALUES ('CUST-TESLA-01','客户-特斯拉工厂','CUST',DATE '2026-01-10');

    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('RAW-RUBBER-001','SEMI-COMPOUND-101',500);
    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('RAW-CARBON-002','SEMI-COMPOUND-101',200);
    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('SEMI-COMPOUND-101','SEMI-TREAD-201',300);
    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('SEMI-TREAD-201','FG-TIRE-DOT-8888',1);
    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('SEMI-TREAD-201','FG-TIRE-DOT-9999',1);
    INSERT INTO lot_genealogy VALUES ('FG-TIRE-DOT-8888','CUST-TESLA-01',1);
    COMMIT;
END;
/
</code></pre>
<h2 id="03--正查与反查">03 | 正查与反查</h2>
<p>Oracle 的 <code>CONNECT BY</code> 层次查询很适合这类树形结构。正查从缺陷原材料出发，找出所有下游成品与客户：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT LEVEL AS hierarchy_level,
       SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(parent_lot_id,' -&gt; ') || ' -&gt; ' || child_lot_id AS full_trace_path,
       parent_lot_id AS source_lot,
       child_lot_id  AS target_lot,
       m.item_name   AS target_item_name,
       m.item_type   AS target_item_type
FROM lot_genealogy g
JOIN lot_master m ON g.child_lot_id = m.lot_id
START WITH g.parent_lot_id = 'RAW-RUBBER-001'
CONNECT BY PRIOR g.child_lot_id = g.parent_lot_id;
</code></pre>
<p>反查从问题轮胎出发，向上追查所用半成品与原材料：</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT LEVEL AS hierarchy_level,
       SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(child_lot_id,' &lt;- ') || ' &lt;- ' || parent_lot_id AS reverse_trace_path,
       child_lot_id  AS current_lot,
       parent_lot_id AS component_lot,
       m.item_name   AS component_name,
       m.item_type   AS component_type
FROM lot_genealogy g
JOIN lot_master m ON g.parent_lot_id = m.lot_id
START WITH g.child_lot_id = 'FG-TIRE-DOT-8888'
CONNECT BY PRIOR g.parent_lot_id = g.child_lot_id;
</code></pre>
<p>两条查询的差别只在 <code>START WITH</code> 的起点和 <code>CONNECT BY PRIOR</code> 的连接方向，可以用一张对照图记住这个规律：</p>
<div class="mermaid">flowchart TB
    subgraph FW["正查 Forward Tracking"]
        direction TB
        A1["START WITH parent_lot_id = 缺陷原材料"] --&gt; A2["CONNECT BY PRIOR child_lot_id = parent_lot_id"]
        A2 --&gt; A3["结果：下游半成品 / 成品 / 客户"]
    end
    subgraph BW["反查 Backward Tracking"]
        direction TB
        B1["START WITH child_lot_id = 问题轮胎DOT码"] --&gt; B2["CONNECT BY PRIOR parent_lot_id = child_lot_id"]
        B2 --&gt; B3["结果：上游半成品 / 原材料"]
    end
</div><h2 id="04--最佳实践">04 | 最佳实践</h2>
<p><strong>防止环路。</strong> 返工回炉可能造成 A→B→A 的循环，触发 <code>ORA-01436</code>。建议加上 <code>NOCYCLE</code>，并配合 <code>CONNECT_BY_ISCYCLE</code> 识别环路。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">CONNECT BY NOCYCLE PRIOR g.child_lot_id = g.parent_lot_id
</code></pre>
<p><strong>索引必建。</strong> 递归性能取决于索引。本表主键 <code>(parent_lot_id, child_lot_id)</code> 已可支撑正查方向；反查方向需要额外索引 <code>(child_lot_id, parent_lot_id)</code>。若主键定义不同，请按实际执行计划确认所需索引。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sql">-- 1. 主键自动创建正查复合索引：(parent_lot_id, child_lot_id)
ALTER TABLE lot_genealogy ADD CONSTRAINT pk_lot_genealogy 
PRIMARY KEY (parent_lot_id, child_lot_id);

-- 2. 只需要手动创建反查复合索引：(child_lot_id, parent_lot_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_genealogy_bw ON lot_genealogy(child_lot_id, parent_lot_id);
</code></pre>
<p><strong>控制深度。</strong> 只需追到直接半成品时，用 <code>WHERE LEVEL &lt;= N</code> 限定层数，减少开销。</p>
<p><strong>路径拼接注意。</strong> <code>SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH</code> 的分隔符不能出现在字段值中，拼接结果也不能超过 <code>VARCHAR2</code> 长度上限；层级过深导致超限时会报错，此时可改用 <code>CONNECT_BY_ROOT</code> 或只保留关键层级，避免拼接完整路径。</p>
<h2 id="05--何时升级到属性图">05 | 何时升级到属性图</h2>
<p><code>CONNECT BY</code> 能覆盖多数单树与简单 DAG 追溯。但遇到多关系网状结构时，关系型递归会吃力，可考虑 Oracle 26ai 内置的 Operational Property Graph。</p>
<p>典型场景是设备交叉污染：混炼机发生润滑油泄漏后，未彻底清洗前生产的所有批次都受影响。此时设备、批次、人员、车间都是节点，用图模式匹配能一句查出跨实体的影响范围。另一类是残料回用与复配形成的多对多网状交织，关系型递归容易因大量去重与 Join 出现性能瓶颈，而图引擎的邻接索引在高并发下更稳定。</p>
<p>关注我，和AI一起成长~</p>
